column1: # forms.tsv -- every form this assembler claims to support, one probe per line.
# tools/coverage.sh requires each probe to assemble AND its shape (tools/shape.awk)
# to appear in at least one test input. So this file is both the claim and the
# to-do list: a row whose shape is in no test is a red gate, with a name.
# A row is a source line, not a shape, on purpose: it is assembled for real, so a
# form that was removed or renamed fails here instead of leaving a stale claim.
# A label may prefix the line (`q: jmp q`) so branches can be probed standalone.
# Not covered here, deliberately: values. `mov eax, 1` and `mov eax, 0x7fffffff`
# are one shape; the literal forms are pinned by tests/capability/ instead.
# --- and / or / test / xor (immediate and register forms) ------------------
# --- added when the gate first ran: .l variants of jb and jnz were used by the
# corpus but not claimed here (the inventory was incomplete, not the corpus)
# --- 64-bit forms: the width comes from the operand names, not the opcode ---
# --- disp32: displacements that do not fit in a signed byte ----------------
